title: Structures and stability of N7+ and N7- clusters
authors: Yong Dong Liu, Jun Fang Zhao, Qian Shu Li

species.method: B3LYP/6-311(+)G* (paper's preferred level; HF/6-31G*, B3LYP/6-31G*, MP2/6-31G* also given in Fig. 1a/Table 1)

bond_params.shape: open-chain, C2v; terminal bond close to N2 triple bond, central bonds between double-bond (HN=NH, 1.252 A) and aromatic (1.350 A) N-N length
bond_params.figure_note: Fig. 1a in the PDF (page 3 of the file) has the FULL set of bond lengths/angles at all 4 levels of theory annotated directly on the structure drawing -- only the prose-quoted subset is transcribed here for safety/certainty of atom-bond assignment; re-read the figure directly for a complete Z-matrix if needed.

species.notes: GLOBAL MINIMUM for N7+ (charge=+1), genuine local minimum at all 4 levels of theory (lowest freq 123-139 cm-1 depending on level, all real). B3LYP/6-311(+)G* total energy -382.8410263 au. THIS IS A NEW CHARGE STATE not present in N7.json or n7b.json (those are neutral N7 only) -- important addition for the cation family comparison table.

bond_params.shape: composed of three fused four-membered rings; high energy (+215 to +276 kcal/mol above structure 1 depending on level)

species.suggested_build: UNKNOWN (fused polycyclic, not in current geom.py list)
species.notes: Genuine local minimum at all 4 levels (all real vibrational frequencies) despite very high relative energy. Full bond lengths/angles annotated in Fig. 1b (not transcribed here, see figure directly).

UNSTABLE: local minimum only at HF/MP2 levels; has an IMAGINARY frequency at B3LYP and collapses (following the imaginary mode) to an N5+.N2 van der Waals complex ('2-complex', Cs symmetry). Not a genuine N7+ minimum at the higher level of theory -- exclude from any relaxation pool or treat as a curiosity only.

bond_params.shape: spiro structure, three- and five-membered rings perpendicularly fused

species.notes: UNSTABLE: obtained only at HF/6-31G*; at B3LYP and MP2 it collapses to a C2v complex ('3-complex') containing an N3 three-membered ring plus two N2 fragments. Exclude from relaxation pool.

species.method: B3LYP/6-311+G* (paper's preferred level for the anion)

bond_params.shape: open-chain, most stable N7- species; N2-N4/N4-N6 double bonds (NLMO), N1-N2 single bond

species.notes: GLOBAL MINIMUM for N7- (charge=-1) -- 'most stable species among the N7- clusters'. Local minimum at HF/B3LYP-6-31G* but has 2 imaginary freqs at MP2/6-31G* and 1 at B3LYP/6-311+G* -- following the imaginary mode gives an all-real C2-symmetric structure (dihedral N3-N1-N2-N4 = 150.2 deg MP2 / 175.4 deg B3LYP) -- so treat as C2v/C2 near-degenerate pair, similar situation to the neutral N7 chain in N7.json. B3LYP/6-311+G* energy -383.1972773 au. NEW CHARGE STATE, important for anion family comparison.

bond_params.shape: six-membered ring in boat conformation, N1-N6/N5-N6 = 1.464 A, N2-N3/N3-N4 = 1.344 A

species.suggested_build: general_ring or generic_guess(shape="ring", n_atoms=6, plus one exocyclic/substituent atom)
species.notes: Genuine local minimum at ALL 4 levels (all real vibrational frequencies per text and Table 3) -- close second to structure 5 (within 0.3-3.7 kcal/mol depending on level, actually LOWER than 5 at HF and B3LYP/6-31G*). Negative charge mainly on N1 (-0.40), N2/N3 (-0.18), N6/N7 (-0.28).

bond_params.shape: cage of two five-membered rings, two trigonal (3-membered) rings, and one four-membered ring

species.notes: Only exists at HF/6-31G*; B3LYP and MP2 optimizations collapse it to a complex ('7-complex', Cs). Treat as HF-level artifact, not a robust minimum.
